# mg35-win8-wp8-ouya

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license.

## Purpose

Two old MonoGame 3.5 platform projects in one folder: a Windows Phone 8 project (`MonoGamePlatform` `WindowsPhone8`, with a `Content.mgcb` whose platform is `WindowsPhone8`) and an OUYA project (`MonoGamePlatform` `Ouya`). Neither can become a desktop game. They are never built.

## Positive for

MG015, MG016, MG024.
